Packaging update for the Claude plugin directory. No change to what the skill does.

- The plugin now lives in its own `plugin/` folder, so installing it downloads only the skill (about 200 KB), not the examples and screenshots.
- Smaller plugin icon.
- Install instructions no longer chain download and run commands.

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install flow-chart --marketplace naeemakram/flow-chart-skill`
Claude apps: download `flow-chart.zip` below and upload it under Settings → Capabilities → Skills.
